# Third-Party Libraries

This directory contains third-party libraries used by Geo2DGS-SLAM.

- [Lietorch](https://github.com/princeton-vl/lietorch) — commit [0fa9ce8](https://github.com/princeton-vl/lietorch/tree/0fa9ce8ffca86d985eca9e189a99690d6f3d4df6)
- [Simple-KNN](https://github.com/camenduru/simple-knn) — commit [44f7642](https://github.com/camenduru/simple-knn/tree/44f764299fa305faf6ec5ebd99939e0508331503)
- [Evaluate 3D Reconstruction](https://github.com/eriksandstroem/evaluate_3d_reconstruction_lib)
- [Diff-Surfel Rasterization](https://github.com/hbb1/diff-surfel-rasterization) — commit [e0ed020](https://github.com/hbb1/diff-surfel-rasterization/tree/e0ed0207b3e0669960cfad70852200a4a5847f61)
- [LightGlue](https://github.com/cvg/LightGlue)
- [torch-scatter](https://github.com/rusty1s/pytorch_scatter)
